nodes.name: Elle Reeve
nodes.description: CNN journalist who conducted the aired CNN interview of Candace Owens; introduced in this episode and relevant as the named questioner in the "Zionist-occupied government" exchange.

nodes.name: Zohran Mamdani
nodes.description: NYC Democratic mayoral primary winner referenced in Tucker Carlson and Ben Shapiro stage discussions; relevant as the named political figure in the Mamdani-coverage dispute between Shapiro and Carlson.

nodes.name: Ariana
nodes.description: Daily Wire intern identified by Candace Owens at YWLS 2024 as having been dispatched covertly to record Owens. Full surname not stated.

nodes.name: Megyn Kelly Tour Attendee Authenticity Question
nodes.description: Persistent question whether attendees asking questions and applauding at Megyn Kelly tour stops are organic or coordinated. Owens claims they are coordinated by pro-Israel lobby groups (specifically YAF-affiliated individuals).

nodes.name: Shapiro Statement Accuracy Re: Owens' Accusations
nodes.description: Verification target: whether Ben Shapiro's stage characterization that Candace Owens accused Erika Kirk and Seth Dillon of involvement in Charlie Kirk's murder is accurate. Owens denies the characterization in the same episode.

nodes.name: Daily Wire Intern Covert Recording Operation
nodes.description: Persistent target: the alleged Daily Wire practice of dispatching interns (e.g., Ariana) to conservative events to covertly record hosts and feed the recordings into media cycles. Owens claims this was coordinated, in part, by Alyssa Cordova.

claims.label: Shapiro Stage Statement on Tucker's Mamdani Coverage
claims.claim: On the Megyn Kelly tour stage in Florida, Ben Shapiro stated that Tucker Carlson had mentioned Zohran Mamdani once since October 5 and that he (Shapiro) had done 17 separate shows on Mamdani.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain transcripts/recordings of the cited Carlson and Shapiro shows to verify the cited counts and whether Mamdani was mentioned substantively or in passing.

claims.label: Shapiro Labels Owens' Current Conduct "Evil"
claims.claim: On the Megyn Kelly tour stage in Florida, Ben Shapiro stated that "what Candace Owens is doing right now is evil. It is evil what she is doing right now."
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Shapiro's exact phrasing on stage to prior and subsequent statements to determine whether "evil" was used to characterize Owens' investigation, her rhetoric, or both.

claims.label: Shapiro Claims Owens Accused Erika Kirk of Murdering Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: On the Megyn Kelly tour stage, Ben Shapiro stated that Candace Owens is accusing Erika Kirk of murdering Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull transcripts of all Owens episodes cited by him and verify whether any statement directly accuses Erika Kirk of murder, as opposed to criticizing Turning Point USA leadership or the official narrative.

claims.label: Shapiro Claims Owens Accused Seth Dillon of Murder Involvement
claims.claim: On the Megyn Kelly tour stage, Ben Shapiro stated that Candace Owens is accusing TPUSA insiders and other members of the right wing, including Seth Dillon, of being involved in Charlie Kirk's murder.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific Owens episodes in which she discusses Seth Dillon and assess whether she characterizes him as involved in the killing versus as having lied or pressured Charlie.

claims.label: HuffPost Report: Boreing Praised Fuentes on X Space
claims.claim: According to the read-aloud HuffPost article, on March 25th, then-Daily Wire CEO Jeremy Boreing joined Nick Fuentes on X for a live audio chat room, praised Fuentes as "very funny" and "one of the most talented political influencers," and offered only mild criticism; the host says the X Space was hosted by Lauren Chen.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original X Space audio against the HuffPost excerpts and check whether Boring's characterization of Fuentes was later retracted.

claims.label: Boreing Invited Fuentes Onto Daily Wire Shows
claims.claim: According to the read-aloud HuffPost article, Jeremy Boreing said on the X Space that he would be thrilled to have Nick Fuentes on a Daily Wire show.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via the original X Space audio that this invitation was extended unconditionally and identify whether Daily Wire subsequently acted on the invitation.

claims.label: Candace–Charlie Text Exchange Documents Shapiro's Behavior
claims.claim: In text messages the host reads between herself and Charlie Kirk, Kirk tells her she is bigger than Ben Shapiro now, says they have to treat him like noise, that, in a Game of Thrones reference, Shapiro is sending his "incestuous brother" to go try and kill them, and that he views Owens as Kirk's "slave 100%"; the host separately says Shapiro was going on people's shows talking down about her and Kirk and sent his YAF boys and National Review peeps after them.
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate the underlying text messages via metadata, screenshots, or device records to confirm the read-aloud excerpts were not edited.

claims.label: Owens Identified Daily Wire Intern Ariana at YWLS 2024
claims.claim: At YWLS 2024, Candace Owens publicly identified a Daily Wire PR intern named Ariana who, Owens alleged, had been sent covertly to record her, after receiving a tip from an intern with a conscience.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the full name of the intern, confirm her employment status with Daily Wire at the time, and obtain corroboration from contemporaneous attendees or recordings.

claims.label: Owens Stated America Is "Occupied by Zionists" on CNN
claims.claim: During the aired CNN interview, Candace Owens stated, "America is occupied by Zionists," and doubled and then tripled down on the characterization.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the full CNN interview transcript to verify the exact phrasing and surrounding context.

claims.label: Reeve Characterized Owens' Statements as White-Nationalist Tropes
claims.claim: During the aired CNN interview, Elle Reeve stated that themes Owens used in her criticism of Israel were "very familiar" from her coverage of white nationalists for 10 years, and cited the term "Zionist-occupied government" as an example.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full CNN interview and any related Reeve reporting to verify the broader framing of the exchange.

claims.label: Host Says Eric and Lara Trump Spoke at Auburn TPUSA Event
claims.claim: The host says Eric and Lara Trump appeared as speakers at a recent Turning Point USA event at Auburn University following Charlie Kirk's death.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the event date, attendance records, and Turning Point USA's official event listing.

claims.label: Auburn Student Cited $230M From Pro-Israel Groups to Trump
claims.claim: At the Auburn TPUSA event, a student stated in a question that President Trump had taken over $230 million from pro-Israel groups.
claims.investigative_direction: Trace the $230M figure to its underlying donor records, FEC filings, or AIPAC-adjacent donation disclosures to verify the sum and timeframe.

claims.label: Shapiro Has Tweeted That "Israel First" Critique Is Antisemitism
claims.claim: Per a tweet the host shows, Ben Shapiro wrote that accusing any American Jew who is pro-Israel of being "Israel first" is a "pure form of anti-semitism"; the host says it was directed at Nick Fuentes.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original tweet via X/Twitter search or web archives to verify the exact wording, the date, and whether the tweet was later deleted or amended.

claims.label: Shapiro Tweeted Imagery of Ron Paul "Strangling the Jews"
claims.claim: Per tweets the host shows, Ben Shapiro previously posted tweets containing imagery of Ron Paul "leaning forward from the grave and strangling the Jews" and "gripping the pen as he would the neck of a Jew."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original tweets via web archives to verify wording, date, and any subsequent deletion or apology.

claims.label: Shapiro–Carlson Private Text Exchange After Kirk's Death
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Ben Shapiro says he texted Tucker Carlson proposing a joint show on the "DSA threat," that Carlson replied he would spend "the next week or two" thinking about how to be most effective, and that his repeated outreach afterward went unanswered.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the exchange via Carlson or Shapiro public statements, and confirm whether the outreach was conducted on both sides after the cited date.

claims.label: Owens Describes CNN Interview as Occurring Days After Kirk's Death
claims.claim: Candace Owens states that the aired CNN interview with Elle Reeve occurred "a couple of days after Charlie was killed" and was her first interview after his death.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the interview date against CNN's published interview records or the original broadcast timestamp.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Set Out to Make Kelly Disavow Tucker and Candace
claims.claim: The host says that on stage with Megyn Kelly in Florida, Ben Shapiro set out to peer pressure Kelly into disavowing the host and Tucker Carlson by asking her to respond to things neither of them did or said.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full video of the Kelly tour stop and compare Shapiro's questions to Kelly with what the host and Carlson actually said.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm going to peer pressure Megyn Kelly myself. I'm going to make her disavow me. Make her disavow Candace Owens.

claims.label: Host Says Erika-Attack Narrative Was a Non-Organic Operation Shapiro Plays a Part In
claims.claim: The host says the narrative that she attacked Erika was circulated by people making absurd claims, that she recognizes how such 'organic movements' operate behind the scenes, and that Shapiro plays a part in it.
claims.investigative_direction: Trace the earliest accounts and posts pushing the 'Candace attacked Erika' framing and test the host's assertion of coordination with account-level and timing data.
claims.transcript_snippet: you saw this narrative circulating amongst people who were just absurdly making claims that I attacked Erika. And I know what these organic movements look like.

claims.label: Host Says Daily Wire Departing Staff Sign Six-Month Non-Tucker Agreements
claims.claim: The host says people leaving the Daily Wire have to sign agreements that they will not go work for Tucker Carlson for six months.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain a Daily Wire separation agreement or a former employee's account confirming a six-month restriction on working for Carlson's outlet.
claims.transcript_snippet: people at the Daily Wire when they're leaving the Daily Wire have to sign agreements that they're not going to go work for Tucker Carlson for 6 months.

claims.label: Host Says Tucker and Shapiro Spoke the Day Kirk Died
claims.claim: The host says Tucker Carlson and Ben Shapiro had a nice conversation on the day Charlie Kirk died, that Carlson then sent a nice text because Shapiro had called him, and that she guesses Shapiro thought there would be more follow-up than there was.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with Shapiro's own account of the call and text in the Kelly tour clip and any published text screenshots.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tucker and him had a nice conversation on the day that Charlie Kirk died and Tucker then sent a nice text because Ben had called him

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Insinuated Tucker Backed Mamdani
claims.claim: The host says Shapiro insinuated that Tucker Carlson supported Zohran Mamdani and said nice things about him in his conversation with Marjorie Taylor Greene, and plays the clip so listeners can judge.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the full Carlson and Greene episode and Shapiro's stage remarks to see whether Carlson praised or merely explained Mamdani's win.
claims.transcript_snippet: But to the insinuation that Tucker somehow supported Mandani and said like nice things about him when he sat down with Marjgerie Taylor Green, here's actually what Tucker said

claims.label: Clip: Tucker Says Mamdani Primary Win Came the Week DC Focused on Iran
claims.claim: In the played clip, the speaker responding to Marjorie Taylor Greene says he cannot get over what happened in New York City that week, the same week Washington was focused on Iran's nuclear program, when a 32-year-old socialist was elected in the Democratic primary.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the date of the Carlson and Greene episode against the June 2025 New York Democratic primary and the Iran news cycle.
claims.transcript_snippet: And I just can't get over what happened in our biggest city this week, the very same week, that everybody in DC is focused thousands of miles away on the greatest threat we face

claims.label: Clip: Mamdani Was the Only Debate Candidate to Say He Would Not Visit a Foreign Country
claims.claim: In the played clip, a speaker says that in the New York City mayoral debate all the candidates were asked which foreign country they would visit and, the speaker thinks, most said Israel, while Mamdani said he would stay in New York.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the debate transcript for the foreign-country question and each candidate's answer.
claims.transcript_snippet: They were all the candidates were asked, "If you could visit a foreign country, what would it be?" And they of course all had an answer. I think most said Israel.

claims.label: Clip: Megyn Kelly Tells Shapiro Her Position Is That It Is None of Her Business
claims.claim: In the played clip, Megyn Kelly responds to Shapiro's 'evil' remark by saying she does not opine on whether it is evil and that her position is that it is none of her business.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with Kelly's later public statements on the Owens investigation, including those around the same tour stop.
claims.transcript_snippet: but my my position is it's really none of my business.

claims.label: Host Denies Ever Accusing Seth Dillon of Murdering Charlie
claims.claim: The host says she never once accused Seth Dillon of murdering Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Search the host's episode transcripts for any statement tying Seth Dillon to the killing, as opposed to the Hamptons pressure claims.
claims.transcript_snippet: I never once accused Seth Dillon of murdering Charlie Kirk.

claims.label: Host Says Dillon Lied About the Hamptons Meeting and Pressured Charlie on Israel
claims.claim: The host says that what she actually said about Seth Dillon is that he lied about the Hamptons meeting and was pressuring Charlie Kirk about the topic of Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Dillon's public statements about the Hamptons meeting with attendee accounts, emails and calendar records of the August 2025 retreat.
claims.transcript_snippet: Seth Dillon, I told the truth that Seth Dillon lied about the Hampton's meeting and that he was pushing uh he was pressuring Charlie about the topic of Israel.

claims.label: Host Says Her Audience Pressed Her to Cover Erika's Past and Parents
claims.claim: The host says she was getting flack from her own audience for not covering Erika's past or speaking about her parents, and that she has kept her investigation focused on Turning Point USA and why it is telling certain lies.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the host's earlier episodes for coverage of Erika's background to test the claim that she deliberately held it back.
claims.transcript_snippet: I actually was getting flack from my audience for not covering Erika's past or speaking about her parents.

claims.label: Host Says Boring's X Space Happened the Week She Was Fired
claims.claim: The host says Jeremy Boreing, then CEO of the Daily Wire, joined an X Space hosted by Lauren Chen during the week she was fired from the Daily Wire.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the date of the X Space (HuffPost cites March 25) against the date of the host's Daily Wire exit.
claims.transcript_snippet: I distinctly remember the week that I was gloriously fired from the Daily Wire. And during that week, the CEO of the Daily Wire, at the time it was Jeremy Boreing, jumped onto an Xspace hosted by Lauren Chen

claims.label: Host Dates the Boring-Fuentes Conversation to 2024
claims.claim: The host refers to the Daily Wire's position 'in 2024' that its CEO could talk to and praise Nick Fuentes and invite him on the platform; the article read aloud gives only 'March 25th'.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the year of the X Space; the existing claim C-2510 gives March 25, 2025, which the transcript does not state.
claims.transcript_snippet: when the Daily Wire position in 2024 was that their CEO could talk to Nick Fuentes publicly, praise Nick Fuentes publicly

claims.label: Clip: Fuentes Tells Boring That Shapiro Cannot Say 'Christ Is King'
claims.claim: In the played X Space audio, Nick Fuentes says he dislikes that guys like Shapiro will not say 'Christ is king' or 'America first' and that he thinks they forfeit their ability to lead.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full X Space recording and confirm the speaker and wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: I don't like that guys like Shapiro cannot will not say Christ is king. America first. I think they forfeit their ability to lead.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Worked Behind the Scenes to Stop Kirk's Rise
claims.claim: The host asserts as fact that Ben Shapiro did a lot of things behind the scenes to stop the rise of Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the host's text threads with Kirk and corroboration from third parties about Shapiro's actions.
claims.transcript_snippet: it is just a fact that Ben Shapiro did a lot of things behind the scenes to stop the rise of Charlie Kirk.

claims.label: Host Says She Holds Hundreds of Texts on Shapiro Sending YAF and National Review Writers
claims.claim: The host says she has literally hundreds of messages about Ben Shapiro sending his YAF people and National Review people to come after her and Charlie Kirk by writing articles, including a headline about a smear campaign.
claims.investigative_direction: Examine the message archive and the cited YAF-linked articles for authorship and timing.
claims.transcript_snippet: I have literal hundreds of them pertaining to Ben sending his YAF boys, the AF boys, National Review peeps that were coming after us writing articles.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Called Kirk to Lament Their Friendship
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro called Charlie Kirk, lamented that Kirk and the host had a friendship, and warned him that he should not have it.
claims.investigative_direction: Corroborate the call through Kirk's phone records or the text exchange that refers to it; compare with Shapiro's account.
claims.transcript_snippet: Ben called Charlie and he was lamenting the fact that Charlie and I had this friendship and warning him that he shouldn't have him.

claims.label: Host Reads Kirk Text That Shapiro Was Saying 'Control Her' on the Call
claims.claim: The host reads a text from Charlie Kirk saying Shapiro views the host as Kirk's slave and that 'Control her' is what Shapiro was really saying when he called.
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate the text via the original device or metadata and date it relative to Shapiro's call.
claims.transcript_snippet: He views you as my slave 100%. Control her is what he really was saying to me when he called.

claims.label: Host Says Megyn Kelly Was a Good Friend Who Told the Truth About Kirk's Ordeal
claims.claim: The host says Megyn Kelly was a very good friend to Charlie Kirk, that Kirk deeply respected her, and that toward the end she took a principled position on telling the truth about what he was going through.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Kelly's public statements about Kirk's last weeks and what he told her.
claims.transcript_snippet: Megan who was actually a very good friend to Charlie. Charlie deeply respected her and towards the end obviously she took a very principled position on telling the truth about what he was going through

claims.label: Host Says Erika Was Not Working for TPUSA When Charlie Died
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk was not even working for Turning Point USA when Charlie died, and became CEO only afterward.
claims.investigative_direction: Check TPUSA payroll, board and org records for Erika Kirk's role before September 10, 2025, including the September 2 internal memo.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika who wasn't even working for Turning Point USA uh when Charlie died because now she's the CEO

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Congratulated Randy Fine
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro supports and congratulated Randy Fine, who she says tweeted laughing at photos of dead Palestinian babies.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Shapiro's post congratulating Fine and the Fine tweet the host describes.
claims.transcript_snippet: He supports and congratulated Randy Fine who has literally tweeted laughing at photos of dead Palestinian babies.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Interviewed Netanyahu Last Month Without Pressing on Genocide
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro sat down with Benjamin Netanyahu the previous month and asks whether he pressed Netanyahu on the point of genocide, which she says Netanyahu is being tried for.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the date and transcript of Shapiro's Netanyahu interview and check what was asked about Gaza.
claims.transcript_snippet: BB Netanyahu is committing a genocide and Ben Shapiro sat down with him last month.

claims.label: Host Says Fuentes Was Pushed Out of the Market at 18 for Asking About Israel
claims.claim: The host says Nick Fuentes was an 18-year-old who started asking questions about Israel and was artificially pushed out of the market, and that she heard the backstory in Jeremy Boreing's conversation with Fuentes.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the Boring and Fuentes X Space and Fuentes's own account of his dismissal to see what Boring and Shapiro actually conceded.
claims.transcript_snippet: He started asking questions about Israel and he got artificially pushed out of the market when he had his whole life ahead of him.

claims.label: Host Says Shapiro Never Denied Fuentes's Account
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro has never come out and denied anything Nick Fuentes has said about being pushed out of the market.
claims.investigative_direction: Search Shapiro's public statements for any denial or response to Fuentes's account.
claims.transcript_snippet: Ben has never come out and denied anything that Nick Fuentes has said

claims.label: Host Says Fuentes Was Put on the ADL's List
claims.claim: The host says Nick Fuentes seems to have survived without advertisers, sponsors or connections and was put on the ADL's list.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the ADL's published listings for Fuentes and the date he was added.
claims.transcript_snippet: with the entire media writing things about him, being put on the ADL's list, he has proven to be quite resilient.

claims.label: Host Calls Shapiro's Stage Questioning the Moral Blackmail Kirk Described
claims.claim: The host says Shapiro's on-stage questioning of Kelly is exactly the moral blackmail Charlie Kirk was speaking about in the last days of his life.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Kirk's own statements using the phrase moral blackmail and the context in which he used it.
claims.transcript_snippet: That is exactly the moral blackmail that Charlie was speaking about in the last days of his life.

claims.label: Host Says the Kelly Stage Exchange Was Pre-Planned and Not Organic
claims.claim: The host says the exchange with Megyn Kelly was pre-planned and not organic, and that the supporters and the questions were not organic.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the ticketing, seating and attendee data for the Kelly tour stop to test whether the audience reaction was coordinated.
claims.transcript_snippet: It is pre-planned. It is not organic. The supporters are not organic.

claims.label: Host Says Daily Wire Planned to Circulate the Intern's Question as a Random Student
claims.claim: The host says that after being fired she learned of a covert Daily Wire plan to send an intern to ask her a question and then pass around a clip made to look as if the questioner were a random student.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original tipster at the Daily Wire and any message showing the plan to circulate the clip.
claims.transcript_snippet: they were going to pass around a clip, but they were going to make it look like she was just a a random student.

claims.label: Clip: Intern Allegedly Got a 10 p.m. Email and Flew In Posing as a Student
claims.claim: In the played YWLS 2024 audio, the host says the Daily Wire intern apparently got an email at 10 p.m., hopped on a plane and was pretending to be a student.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek the intern's identity, flight and email records, or attendee-list evidence from the event.
claims.transcript_snippet: apparently she got an email at 10 p. m., hopped on a plane, is pretending to be a student.

claims.label: Clip: Host Relays Kirk's Offer to Fly Shapiro to Detroit to Debate
claims.claim: In the played clip, the host says Charlie Kirk will fly Ben Shapiro out the following week to Detroit to debate on Kirk's stage; she later says Kirk told her to call Shapiro out on stage and offer the debate.
claims.investigative_direction: Find any Kirk or TPUSA confirmation of the offer and whether Shapiro replied.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie Kirk says he will fly you out. He will fly you out next week to Detroit and we can do the debates on his stage.

claims.label: Host Says Alyssa Cordova Orchestrated the Intern Operation
claims.claim: The host says the orchestration of the intern and applause operation was by Alyssa Cordova, who she says is no longer at the Daily Wire.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Cordova or former Daily Wire staff about the intern assignment and confirm Cordova's departure date.
claims.transcript_snippet: That was orchestrated by Alyssa Cordova now that she's not at the Daily Wire.

claims.label: Host Says Those Pressing Kelly on Tucker at Her Events Are Paid Pro-Israel Operatives
claims.claim: The host says that people coming to Megyn Kelly's events to ask her to disavow Tucker Carlson are not organic and are pro-Israel people who are paid to do it.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the audience-question sources and any payment or organizational links for the people who asked questions.
claims.transcript_snippet: That is not organic. Okay? That is pro-Israel people that are paid to do it.

claims.label: Host Predicts Kelly's Attendees Include YAF and Other Organization Members
claims.claim: The host says that if Kelly gave her the attendee list she could find the people sent to applaud and intimidate, and predicts they will be from YAF or some other organization.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare any available ticket-holder list for the tour stop with YAF membership and staff rosters.
claims.transcript_snippet: I will find the people from they will be from YAF. They will be from some organization.

claims.label: Host Says the Same Bullying Process Cost the Pro-Israel Lobby Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: The host says the process of bullying and struggle-sessioning Megyn Kelly is the exact one by which the pro-Israel lobby lost Charlie Kirk, as one gets tired of being bullied and senses it is not organic.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with Kirk's own statements about Israel-lobby pressure in the weeks before his death.
claims.transcript_snippet: exact same process by which the pro-Israel lobby lost Charlie Kirk because eventually you just get tired of being bullied

claims.label: Host Says the CNN Interview Was Booked Before and Was Not About Charlie
claims.claim: The host says the CNN interview took place a couple of days after Charlie was killed, was her first interview since, was set up beforehand and was not about Charlie Kirk, and that she kept the appointment.
claims.investigative_direction: Check CNN and the host's team for booking emails and the interview date.
